about_the_game:
Ready to make some noise? m(=•ェ•=)m

Meowzic Survivor is a rhythm-integrated roguelike that fuses addictive survivor-style gameplay with dynamic music mechanics. Unlock heroic cats, arm them with beat-based weapons, and battle through neon-pixel dance floors. Your loadout is your soundtrack—it’s time to conquer the universe with your own rhythmic symphony of destruction!

🎵 Your Weapons ARE Your Music 🎵

Forget static soundtracks. In Meowzic Survivor, every weapon possesses its own unique musical loop. Your firepower flows directly from the rhythm, meaning your combat build is also your custom game music. You aren't just surviving waves; you are the DJ composing a battle symphony in real-time.

🎵 A New Twist on Rhythm & Action 🎵

Master the rhythm-focused mini-games mid-combat to trigger "Fever," granting massive stat boosts and powerful temporary abilities. Layer on effects that transform your audio and your power, ensuring the groove (and the carnage) never stops.

🎵 From Techno to House: Master the Genres 🎵

Dive into a synthwave dreamscape brought to life with vibrant pixel art. Each stage features independent musical styles—from deep Techno to high-energy House. Face off against challenging bosses that test both your survival instincts and your sense of rhythm.

🎵 DIY Your Audio: Unleash the Chaos 🎵

Want to show off your production skills? Our Custom Audio Support allows you to use your own audio file—be it a professional track, a poem, or a screaming chicken. Let’s see whose "masterpiece" is the most legendary!

Key Features

  • 10+ Heroic Felines: Unlock and play as various cats, each with unique traits and styles.

  • 18 Beat-Based Weapons: A vast arsenal where every blast of power is timed to the music.

  • 5+ Distinct Stages: Explore handcrafted levels, each featuring its own exclusive Boss.

  • Fever Mini-Games: Complete rhythm challenges mid-combat to turn the tide of battle.

  • Stunning Pixel Art: Experience musical chaos in a world of neon lights and pixelated mayhem.

  • Endless Mode & Hidden Secrets: How long can you keep the party jumping?

Whether you're a rhythm game enthusiast, a roguelike fan, or someone looking for a fresh take on action gameplay, Meowzic Survivor delivers an experience where timing, music, and mayhem collide.
